kicker: Patient ne exercise ghar pe chhod di
title: Recovery *ghar ki exercise* se hoti hai. Patient bhool jaata hai.
fix_label: Session ke agle din ye bhejo 👇
message:
Hi [naam] ji 🙏 kal wali exercise [3 sets x 10] ho gayi?
Video yahan hai: [link]
Dard 0-10 mein kitna hai? Bas number reply kar dijiye.
why: number reply = 2 second. *Dard ka trend* aapko pata chalta hai, aur patient ko lagta hai koi dekh raha hai.
caption:
Physio ka asli result clinic ke bahar banta hai: ghar ki exercise. Aur wahi sabse pehle chhootti hai. 🦵

Agle din 1 message:
✅ Kal ki exercise ka reminder
✅ Video link
✅ "Dard 0-10?" (sirf number)

Number badhe to call karo. Patient wapas aata hai, aur doston ko bhi bhejta hai. Save karo 🔖

📲 Ye problem aapke business mein bhi hai? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.
